title: GTA 6 Weather: New Screenshots Show Leonida's Storms
description: GTA 6 weather takes center stage as Rockstar shares new Leonida screenshots via The Weather Channel, just days before the November 19 launch, says IGN.

body.text: GTA 6 weather is the latest thing Rockstar has chosen to show off, and it did so in an unusual way. According to IGN, the studio released a new batch of screenshots of Leonida through The Weather Channel, complete with a forecast-style breakdown. With launch only days away, it is a first proper look at how the skies could shape the game.

IGN says the set contains six images of Vice City under very different conditions, from torrential downpours to ocean fog. The accompanying write-up reads like a real forecast, aimed at future Leonida residents who want to prepare before a storm arrives.

One post tied to the release describes heavy rain pushing moisture into the Keys and making visibility poor in many spots. It also mentions that local authorities have fitted reflectors on some roads to help with driving.
How GTA 6 weather works in Leonida

Rockstar VP of art: light and rendering Owen Shepherd explained the thinking. Leonida is a fictional world inspired by modern-day Florida, and he pointed out that the real state has some of the most unpredictable weather in the US.

To keep up with the rest of the game's detail, Shepherd said the team rebuilt its weather systems from the ground up. The goal was for conditions to feel more localized, persistent and dynamic. He said the range runs from clear blue skies to huge, towering cumulonimbus clouds.
Storms and hurricanes were already confirmed

None of this is a complete surprise. IGN notes that Rockstar told Game Informer in September that it had built an advanced weather system. A later update added that Vice City can be hit by simulated tropical storms and hurricanes.

Those events were described as bringing heavy clouds, strong winds, dense atmospherics and a lot of rain. IGN points out that this suggests more than a cosmetic change, as the weather appears to be a real part of the world rather than a backdrop.
The outlet also adds a caution. Six screenshots show plenty of variety, but there is no reason to think they cover everything the skies of Leonida can do.

IGN reports that GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. The article frames it as the end of a 13-year wait for a proper return to Vice City. Nothing in the source mentions other platforms, so Indian players should plan around those two consoles for launch day.

With only days left, the main question is whether Rockstar shares more in the final stretch. Before this, nobody knew whether the week would bring leaks, gameplay details or more footage, and a weather forecast was not on anyone's list. Watch for more official material from Rockstar and for how storms and hurricanes actually play out once the game is in players' hands on November 19.

faqs.q: When is the GTA 6 release date?
faqs.a: According to IGN, GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

faqs.q: Will GTA 6 have hurricanes and storms?
faqs.a: Yes. IGN reports that a Rockstar update after the September Game Informer interview said Vice City can be hit by simulated tropical storms and hurricanes, bringing heavy clouds, strong winds, dense atmospherics and a lot of rain.

faqs.q: How many new GTA 6 weather screenshots did Rockstar release?
faqs.a: IGN says there are six new screenshots, published through The Weather Channel, showing conditions from torrential downpours to ocean fog. The outlet notes they probably don't cover everything Leonida's skies can do.

sources.title: GTA 6 Gets New Screenshots Highlighting Leonida's Dynamic Weather
